notes: Units: capacity_mwac in MWac; every *_mwp field in MWp (MWp = MWac x ol).
Dates are display strings 'DD-Mon-YY' (e.g. 31-Dec-26), not ISO.
ftc_date / tc_date / module_date join several phases with ' · ', e.g. 'Ph-I (150MW): 09-Dec-26 · Ph-II (150MW): 03-Jan-27'. Completed phases are omitted.
tc_date = FTC - 45 days; module_date = TC - lead time (China/SEA 136 d, others 98 d). Both are derived, not measured.
Some rows have capacity 0 or type 'Unknown' where the mapping sheet is incomplete - filter or check them.
Filter ongoing projects with is_commissioned == false.

ai_review_changes.before:
Executive Summary
AI recommends placing the order now; modules are expected at site around 2027-01-13 (latest 2027-02-12), giving first charging around 2028-01-14. Risk level: HIGH.

Rule vs AI Assessment
Rule Engine ordering date 2026-10-17 and AI date 2026-06-09 differ by 130 days - the AI orders earlier because it uses measured lead times and the realistic FTC.

Key Drivers
• 157.07 MWp of this phase is still to order (496.9 MWp across the project).
• Inventory 10.1 MWp, received 198.1 MWp, in transit 0 MWp.
• Measured supplier lead time 94 days (P90 124) for SEA supply vs 136 days in the rule engine.
• Site readiness predicted to push FTC 273 days past P6 (Aop vs ftc (days): -77; Rule-engine priority on P6 dates: P1; Structure behind plan by 6 points; Inventory shortage at site).
• Modules needed at site: Oct-26 462.1 MWp, Nov-26 34.8 MWp (site speed timing).

Risks Identified
• FTC Risk: Projected charging 2028-01-14 is after the AOP (2027-01-29).
• Vendor Capacity Risk: Order window already passed - order immediately.

Business Impact
• SCOD impact: Projected charging lands 350 days after the AOP.
• LD impact: Liquidated damages exposure is likely unless the order is expedited.

Recommended Actions
• Place the order now and secure the vendor slot.
• Track shipment milestones weekly against the predicted delivery date.
• Escalate to the project head: speed up structure work (steel supply, crews) - site readiness, not supply, sets the charging date.
• Pace deliveries to structure readiness - earlier delivery only adds yard stock.

ai_review_changes.before:
Executive Summary
AI recommends placing the order by 2027-05-31; modules are expected at site around 2027-06-27 (latest 2027-09-01), giving first charging around 2028-03-31. Risk level: HIGH.

Rule vs AI Assessment
Rule Engine ordering date 2026-06-07 and AI date 2027-05-31 differ by 358 days - the AI can order later because it uses measured lead times and the realistic FTC.

Key Drivers
• 15.7 MWp of this phase is still to order (15.7 MWp across the project).
• Inventory 391.3 MWp, received 800.3 MWp, in transit 0 MWp.
• Measured supplier lead time 27 days (P90 93) for China supply vs 136 days in the rule engine.
• Site readiness predicted to push FTC 227 days past P6 (LTA 482 days after FTC; Rule-engine priority on P6 dates: P2; Structure behind plan by 29 points; Vendor lead time: 136).
• LTA 2028-03-31 is after the AOP - the phase can wait for transmission.
• Modules needed at site: Sep-27 15.7 MWp (site speed timing).

Risks Identified
• FTC Risk: Projected charging 2028-03-31 is after the AOP (2027-01-27).
• Transmission Risk: LTA 2028-03-31 after the AOP: transmission, not supply, binds.

Business Impact
• SCOD impact: Projected charging lands 429 days after the AOP.
• LTA impact: LTA 2028-03-31 after the AOP: transmission, not supply, binds.
• LD impact: Liquidated damages exposure is likely unless the order is expedited.

Recommended Actions
• Place the order by 2027-05-31 and secure the vendor slot.
• Track shipment milestones weekly against the predicted delivery date.
• Escalate the transmission (LTA) date; ordering earlier would only add yard stock.
• Pace deliveries to structure readiness - earlier delivery only adds yard stock.
